Messages.Author: John M. Baker
Messages.Body:
Does a vampire with Masochism get rush counters from taking
damage from Daring the Dawn or Force of Will?

John Baker

Messages.Author: Kristyl Meth
Messages.Body:
> Does a vampire with Masochism get rush counters from taking
> damage from Daring the Dawn or Force of Will?

The vamp would get rush counters if combat occurred and the opposing minion
inflicted damage on the vamp (only in the amount of damage inflicted by the
other minion, though). Any type of environmental damage (Force of Will,
Rutor's Hand, grenades at close range, zip gun, etc.) doesn't count for
rush counters.

KM

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
